Bewirb’ dich also gerne, wenn du die notwendigen Kenntnisse und Lust hast, uns in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Tätigkeitsfelder zu unterstützen:

Fokus auf Produktmanagement:

Fokus auf Kundensupport:

  • Du unterstützt unsere KundInnen bei Fragen oder Problemen rund um unser Angebot.

Fokus auf Marketing und/oder Design:

Die RoX Health GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin ist ein Venture Builder und eigenständiges Tochterunternehmen des Gesundheitskonzerns Roche. Zusammen mit Partnern arbeiten wir aktuell an Innovationen in den Bereichen Onkologie, Neurologie und Frauengesundheit. Woran glauben wir?

Die Zukunft der Medizin ist patientenzentriert, personalisiert und digitalisiert.

jobs.title: Senior IGA Consultant, Identity Governance and Access Controls
jobs.description:
Intelance is building a trusted associate team for identity governance and access control work in regulated and complex organisations.

We are looking for a Senior IGA Consultant to turn access evidence into clear findings, practical access rules and delivery ready actions. The first likely assignment supports a financial services client reviewing who can see and change sensitive client information across Microsoft, data and business platforms.

This is an associate contract. Work is assigned through paid work orders after client approval. The first assignment is expected to be a focused number of delivery days, with the possibility of later pilot, access review and recurring governance work.

Tasks

Working with the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant, you will:

• Analyse user, group, role, permission and service account exports.

• Reconcile technical access with the business reason for access.

• Identify broad, stale, direct and conflicting access, and record the evidence for each point.

• Carry out role mining and draft role and access matrices.

• Test joiner, role change and leaver controls, including where old access is removed.

• Draft clear findings that state the system, affected access, evidence, risk and required decision.

• Support access reviews and certification so business owners can make informed decisions.

• Review privileged accounts, service accounts and integration identities.

• Support access testing for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and connected business systems.

• Maintain the findings register, evidence record and implementation backlog.

• Support pilot testing and confirm that completed changes match the approved design.

You will not be expected to act as the overall design authority. The Principal IAM Consultant owns the target access design and final technical challenge.

Requirements

Essential:

• Strong recent experience delivering identity governance or access control work in a complex organisation.

• Hands on experience analysing users, groups, roles, permissions and access grants.

• Practical role mining and role based access control experience.

• Experience designing or operating access reviews, certification and recertification.

• Experience testing joiner, role change and leaver controls.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions.

• Experience reviewing privileged accounts, service accounts or integration access.

• Able to write short, evidence based findings in plain English.

• Comfortable working independently from source records and recorded interviews.

• Based in the United Kingdom and available during UK business hours.

• Available for short, clearly scoped assignments that may grow after client approval.

Strong advantage:

• Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business.

• Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.

• Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or another identity governance platform.

• Experience of segregation of duties analysis.

• Experience reviewing AI tools or connectors that can reach company information.

• Relevant Microsoft identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 certification.

Please apply only if you have personally analysed access evidence and turned it into findings or role design. General project coordination or user administration alone is not enough.

Benefits

  • • Indicative rate of £425 to £500 per day, depending on the assignment and depth of relevant experience.
  • • Fully remote work within the United Kingdom.
  • • Clear work orders, agreed days and defined outputs before each assignment starts.
  • • Direct access to the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant.
  • • Focused work on real access problems in regulated organisations.
  • • Potential follow on work across design, pilot delivery, access reviews and recurring governance.
  • • Prompt payment against agreed timesheets and completed work.

Please submit your CV and answer the application questions fully.

We will first check whether your recent work matches the evidence analysis and role design needed. Suitable candidates will then have a short screening call and a structured technical discussion based on a real access scenario.

This is an associate opportunity. No minimum number of days is guaranteed. Each assignment is subject to client approval, an agreed work order and confirmed delivery dates.

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.

This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.

You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.

  • Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.

  • Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.

  • Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.

  • Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.

  • Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.

  • Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.

  • Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.

 

What do we need from you?

  • You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.

  • A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.

  • Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.

  • You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.

  • Experience running competitive intelligence or win/loss programs.

You will run our paid, SEO, and account-based programs yourself, and you will be the person who works out which repeatable, scalable channels actually drive qualified leads, then builds them into an engine.

We do demand gen a particular way. Rather than pushing people to a product page and hoping, we lead with genuine value: free tools, content, and resources that help jewellers run better businesses, and we let that earn the relationship. Your job is to build the acquisition machine around that model and prove, channel by channel, what works.

You will start as an individual contributor with real ownership of the function, working alongside our paid, lifecycle, and GTM engineering talent. As the channels prove out and the work grows, there is a clear path to build and lead a team beneath you.

  • Run our paid channels day to day, Google and Meta to start. For now, the ad accounts are something you are in, not something you hand off.

  • Find and build repeatable, scalable channels that drive qualified leads. The goal is a system, not a string of one-off campaigns.

  • Grow our SEO and AEO (answer-engine) presence, so jewellers find us when they are looking for help, not only when we are paying to reach them.

  • Design and run account-based programs aimed at the specific jewellers we most want as customers.

  • Lean into our value-first model: point spend at free tools and content, like our Jeweller Business Health Check, rather than product pages, and build the funnel that turns that attention into signups.

  • Work inside our attribution from day one. Partner with our data and GTM engineering leads so every channel is measurable and every dollar is accountable.

  • Hand qualified leads off cleanly to the SDR team, and close the loop so you know which channels produce customers, not just clicks.

  • Report on what is working in plain terms, kill what is not, and reinvest in what is.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 5+ years in growth or demand gen, with a track record of building acquisition channels that scaled, not just managing a spend number.

  • Deep, hands-on paid expertise. You can build, run, and optimise Google and Meta campaigns yourself, today.

  • Real experience across more than one channel: paid plus some mix of SEO, ABM, lifecycle, or net-new experiments.

  • You think in systems, repeatable and measurable and scalable, and you are suspicious of any win you cannot explain or repeat.

  • Fluency with attribution and analytics. You start from the numbers and you can defend them.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.
